description.value: Sushi Nova is a Japanese restaurant nestled in Kitsilano, steps from West 4th Avenue and within easy walking distance of Kits Beach. The restaurant offers a broad menu spanning classic rolls, specialty hand rolls, robata, donburi, and sashimi, with a dedicated takeout menu and online ordering. Reviewers consistently highlight fresh ingredients, friendly service, and an inviting atmosphere with good decor.
